_comment: Three-track progression baseline: blank gear/books unlock up to ceil(maxLevel / 2) along regular bookshelves, items already carrying an enchantment can upgrade all the way to MAX at 38 regular bookshelves, and Chiseled Bookshelf Master Tomes always unlock 1:1 immediately alongside 1-3 vanilla XP deduction. Treasure and #chiseled_enchanting_table:epiphany_exclusive enchantments remain exclusive to Master Tomes, Treasure Epiphanies, or direct book transfer.
